lines.text:
MISTY: I heard an interesting rumor!
Not only did you and that other kid defeat
those Team Rocket guys, but you also
met again in the battle for Champion.\c
Argh!
I just can’t take it anymore!\c
You’ve gotten so strong that I just absolutely
have to battle you again!\c
You got that? No refusing!

MISTY: My adorable Pokémon are ready to take
you on!
The ultimate offensive of Water-type Pokémon!\c
I hope you’re ready!

MISTY: I lost...
I need to try swimming around for a bit
so that I can clear my head of these feelings.\c
...I definitely won’t lose next time!
